generate_talking_video.title: Fabric 1.0: image + audio to talking video
generate_talking_video.description: Turn a still image into a talking video lip-synced to an audio track, with VEED Fabric 1.0. Give a face image, the speech audio and a resolution. Use generate_talking_video_fast for a quicker, cheaper render, or generate_talking_video_from_text to have the speech synthesised from text. This submits an asynchronous job to fal's queue and returns immediately with a request_id: poll get_request_status until COMPLETED, then call get_request_result for the output file URL.

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio file to use as the speech track (mp3, wav, m4a…).

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to animate; a clear, front-facing face works best.

webhook_url.description: URL fal should POST the finished result to, instead of you polling for it.

output.description: The queued request: use request_id with get_request_status and get_request_result.

response_url.description: URL the result is served from once COMPLETED.

queue_position.description: Place in the queue while IN_QUEUE.

Fabric 1.0 synthesises a voice matched to the image (steer it with voice_description) and lip-syncs the face to it. Use generate_talking_video when you already have the audio. voice_description.description: Optional additional voice description. The primary voice description is auto-generated from the image. You can use simple descriptors like 'British accent' or 'Confident' or provide a detailed description like 'Confident male voice, mid-20s, with notes of...'

add_subtitles.title: Burn styled subtitles into a video
add_subtitles.description: Transcribe a video (or take your own SRT) and burn animated, styled subtitles into it. Pick the look with `preset`, optionally translate with translation_language, correct brand names with `vocabulary`, and fine-tune position, shadow and fonts with `customization`. Billed per minute of video. This submits an asynchronous job to fal's queue and returns immediately with a request_id: poll get_request_status until COMPLETED, then call get_request_result for the output file URL.

translation_language.description: Translate the subtitles into this language. Omit to keep the original spoken language. If you also pass srt_content or srt_file_url, set `language` to its source language for the most reliable translation.

customization.description: Optional preset overrides: vertical position, shadow intensity, and per-tier text styling (font, weight, hex colour) for each word-importance tier. Any omitted field keeps the preset's default. Fields: shadow, text_customizations, position.

vocabulary.description: Optional list of terms to help auto-transcription correctly recognise brand names and domain jargon that providers commonly mis-spell (e.g. "VEED" → "vid"). Ignored when srt_content / srt_file_url is set. Each item is an object. Fields: word, replaces. Required: word, replaces.

preset.description: Each style defines fonts, colors, layout, and animation. Two tiers with different pricing: - Dynamic presets (2x multiplier): glass, whisper, glide2, fusion, glide, terminal, handwritten, backdrop, backdrop2. Richer, context-aware rendering that adapts to the input.

video_url.description: Upload or paste a URL to the video you want to subtitle.

srt_content.description: Paste raw SRT subtitle text. Alternative to srt_file_url. When provided, transcription is skipped.

language.description: Improves transcription accuracy, and should match the source audio (not output subtitles).

srt_file_url.description: Upload or paste a URL to your .srt subtitles file. When provided, transcription is skipped.

webhook_url.description: URL fal should POST the finished result to, instead of you polling for it.

output.description: The queued request: use request_id with get_request_status and get_request_result.

response_url.description: URL the result is served from once COMPLETED.

queue_position.description: Place in the queue while IN_QUEUE.

remove_video_background.title: Remove a video's background
remove_video_background.description: Remove the background from any video of people or objects, with no green screen needed. Returns a VP9 video with an alpha channel, or separate RGB and alpha H.264 videos. Use remove_video_background_fast for speed, or remove_green_screen for chromakey footage. This submits an asynchronous job to fal's queue and returns immediately with a request_id: poll get_request_status until COMPLETED, then call get_request_result for the output file URL.

output_codec.description: Single VP9 video with alpha channel or two videos (rgb and alpha) in H264 format. H264 is recommended for better RGB quality. Provider default: vp9.

video_url.description: Public URL of the source video.

refine_foreground_edges.description: Improves the quality of the extracted object's edges. Provider default: True.

subject_is_person.description: Set to False if the subject is not a person. Provider default: True.

webhook_url.description: URL fal should POST the finished result to, instead of you polling for it.

output.description: The queued request: use request_id with get_request_status and get_request_result.

response_url.description: URL the result is served from once COMPLETED.

queue_position.description: Place in the queue while IN_QUEUE.

Raise spill_suppression_strength if green fringes remain. Use remove_video_background for footage without a green screen. This submits an asynchronous job to fal's queue and returns immediately with a request_id: poll get_request_status until COMPLETED, then call get_request_result for the output file URL.

spill_suppression_strength.description: Increase the value if green spots remain in the video, decrease if color changes are noticed on the extracted subject. Provider default: 0.8.

clean_audio.title: Clean Audio: remove background noise
clean_audio.description: Remove background noise from speech in an audio or video file (up to 30 minutes, 512 MB) and return 48 kHz loudness-normalised audio, using the model behind Clean Audio in the VEED editor. Tune how much room tone survives with `strength` and the output level with target_lufs. This submits an asynchronous job to fal's queue and returns immediately with a request_id: poll get_request_status until COMPLETED, then call get_request_result for the output file URL.

output_format.description: Container for the 48 kHz mono 16-bit output. FLAC is lossless at about half the size of WAV. Provider default: flac.

audio_url.description: The recording to clean. Any audio or video ffmpeg can decode (wav, mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, mp4, mov, webm, ...); a video's audio track is used and multi-channel input is mixed down to mono. Up to 30 minutes and 512 MB. A public URL or a data URI.

target_lufs.description: Integrated loudness of the output (ITU-R BS.1770). The default -19 LUFS is the level the VEED editor delivers; true peak is capped at -1.1 dBTP. Pass null through the API to skip loudness normalization and keep the input level.

strength.description: How much of the original is allowed to remain under speech: the suppression floor is 1 - strength (the default 0.874 is the validated -18 dB). Lower keeps more room tone behind the voice; silence between words is always fully cleaned.

webhook_url.description: URL fal should POST the finished result to, instead of you polling for it.

output.description: The queued request: use request_id with get_request_status and get_request_result.

response_url.description: URL the result is served from once COMPLETED.

queue_position.description: Place in the queue while IN_QUEUE.

get_request_status.title: Get a request's status
get_request_status.description: Check where a submitted VEED job is: IN_QUEUE (with queue_position), IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED. Poll this after any generate tool; once COMPLETED, fetch the output with get_request_result. Set logs to 1 to include the model's log lines.

app.description: The VEED app the request was submitted to: the first path segment of the model, without any /text, /fast or /v2 suffix.

request_id.description: The request_id returned when the job was submitted.

logs.description: 1 to include log lines in the response, 0 (default) to leave them out.

queue_position.description: Place in the queue while IN_QUEUE.

metrics.description: Timing metrics such as inference_time, once COMPLETED.

response_url.description: URL the result is served from.

get_request_result.title: Get a request's result
get_request_result.description: Fetch the output of a COMPLETED VEED job: the generated file's URL, content type and size (under `video`, or `audio` for clean_audio). Call get_request_status first; a request that is still running has no result yet. Output URLs are hosted by fal and should be downloaded promptly.

app.description: The VEED app the request was submitted to: the first path segment of the model, without any /text, /fast or /v2 suffix.

request_id.description: The request_id returned when the job was submitted.

video.description: The generated video file: url, content_type, file_name, file_size. Background removal returns a list of files (one VP9 with alpha, or RGB and alpha for H.264).

audio.description: The cleaned audio file (clean_audio only): url, content_type, file_name, file_size.

audio_duration.description: Duration of the processed audio in seconds (clean_audio only).

cancel_request.title: Cancel a queued request
cancel_request.description: Cancel a submitted VEED job that has not finished yet. A request still IN_QUEUE is removed without charge; one already IN_PROGRESS may not be stoppable. Returns whether the cancellation was accepted.

app.description: The VEED app the request was submitted to: the first path segment of the model, without any /text, /fast or /v2 suffix.

request_id.description: The request_id returned when the job was submitted.
